title: echoes VIP
description: echoes is a Vertically Integrated Project at RIT. I am a web developer, meaning I help add new features to their website and help fix bugs as they come up. I work part time for course credit and can work on whatever part of the website I want to. This past semester, I created their brand guide, a page to show off current opportunities in the project, helped implement images into their game pages, and updated the web documentation.

title: Synonym Web
description: I made this project as part of a Web Development class to learn how to use APIs. The webpage calls the Merriam-Webster Thesaurus API to return a list of synonyms for any given word. The page then makes a game out of it by asking users to input a start and end word and then try to get from one word to another by connecting mutual synonyms. I made this in about two weeks and it taught me a lot about JavaScript and using it to call and parse results from an API using AJAX principles.
skillsList: APIs, AJAX, JavaScript, CSS, Layout Design
altText: Thesaurus search results displayed on a webpage, with search history on the left.

title: A Shrimp In Space
description: This was a game I worked on as part of a 48 hour game jam called Roll Your Fate from November 13-15, 2026. The game is an idle ship-building game where players link components of a spaceship to produce resources to buy more spaceship parts. I did all the UI for this game. I designed a mockup for the UI in Figma (pictured) and then implemented it in Godot in 48 hours. I actually learned how to do UI in Godot during the time period for this game jam. This was my first game jam and first time working in any game engine and I'm very proud of how it turned out.
skillsList: UI, Game Engines, Figma, Godot, Adobe Illustrator
altText: Game UI with a metallic looking panel on the right side with a shop menu displayed on it.

title: WITR Library Project
description: RIT's radio station, WITR 89.7, has the second largest privately owned CD and Vinyl collection in the state of New York. The Library Project aims to label, organize, and catalgue all of our CDs, and preserve all our vinyls. As Assistant Librarian, I am in charge of cataloging every CD into our own database, as well as being one of two people involved in leading a team of volunteers organizing this collection. We also have a collection of DAT recordings from the 90's that we are currently working to archive.
skillsList: Databases, Organization, C#, Volunteer Recruiting, Library Management

title: Howe Caverns Poster
description: This was my final project for New Media Design Digital Survey I. We were challenged to make a poster mimicking the style of the National Park posters for a place that doesn't currently have one. I chose Howe Caverns because it let me experiment with perspective, having the visitor center on top above the cave in a side view. The poster layout was disigned by compositing real images of the cave together, and then vector graphics were drawn to fit the visible shapes and stylize the image.
skillsList: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Vector Graphics, Graphic Design, Photography
altText: A national parks-style poster of Howe's Caverns in Eastern New York, with the cavern visibile below the welcome center.
